title: Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Amendment Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Amendment Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXV OF 2018
ACT XXXV OF 2018
LEGAL PRACTITIONERS AND BAR COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act further to amend the Legal Practitioners and
Bar Councils Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
4th June, 2018]
No.
F.9(28)/2018-Legis, dated 1.6.2018.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on 30th May,
2018 and is hereby published for general information:-
WHEREAS it is
expedient further to amend the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973
(XXXV of 1973) for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Legal Practitioners and
Bar Councils (Amendment) Act, 2018,
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

2018 and is hereby published for general information:-
WHEREAS it is
expedient further to amend the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973
(XXXV of 1973) for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
11. Insertion of
section 52 in Act XXXV of 1973.---In the said Act, after
section 51, the following section 52 shall be inserted, namely:-
"52. Execution of an order of a Bar Council, a
Committee or Tribunal.---Subject to this Act and the rules
made under it, every order of a Bar Council, a Committee or a Tribunal shall be
executable:
(a) in case of
Pakistan Bar Council, its Committee or Tribunal as if it is an order of the
Supreme Court; and
(b) in case of
Provincial Bar Council, its Committee or Tribunal as if it is an order of a
High Court."

Councils and Bar Associations.---The Minister in charge of the Federal
Government or a Provincial Government may make grant in aid to a Bar Council or

Federal Government or the Provincial Government."
